principles: Preserve live diagnostics: milestone_status must continue to reflect current freshness.
Snapshot only accepted closure: closeout artifacts must be generated only from complete, risk-free milestone reports.
Keep the surface host-neutral and read-only for consumers.
Reuse existing milestone projection logic instead of duplicating status rules.
drivers: DONE merge/version changes can stale live evidence after accepted closure.
The user needs a final table with solved problem and evidence columns.
The implementation must stay scoped to milestone closeout behavior and tests/docs.

options.name: add-closeout-command-and-done-snapshot
pros: Separates live diagnostic from historical closeout truth
Gives users a stable explicit command
cons: Requires one new command and storage artifact

options.name: change-milestone-status-to-read-historical-done
pros: DONE stories would appear green by default
cons: Changes semantics of an existing command

options.name: only-document-agent-final-summary
cons: Does not mechanically solve the problem

rationale: A separate closeout snapshot and read-only closeout command preserves the existing live diagnostic while giving DONE stories a mechanically inspectable final table.

preMortem.scenario: Snapshot captures stale or incomplete milestones as final success
preMortem.trigger: DONE path writes snapshot without checking completed group and risks
preMortem.consequence: Users see a false final table
preMortem.mitigation: Build snapshot only from reports where every row is completed or not applicable and risks are empty; test risk-bearing refusal.

preMortem.scenario: Closeout command mutates story state or refreshes evidence
preMortem.trigger: Command reuses write-capable path or accepts mutation flags
preMortem.mitigation: Use a dedicated read-only handler boundary and negative CLI tests for mutation-like flags.

preMortem.trigger: Implementation silently switches DONE stories to historical snapshots
preMortem.consequence: Users cannot detect current material drift
preMortem.mitigation: Keep milestone_status live; expose snapshot through milestone_closeout or explicit closeout mode only.
